description: Revoke one private share token so the link containing it stops opening the scene, or list the active tokens. Use it when the user wants to cut off a link they sent: call with only `scene` to list active `shareId`s, then again with `share_id`. To make the whole scene public or unlisted again, use create_share_link. Parameters: `scene` (id or link) and optional `share_id` from create_share_link or the list call; the list shows each token's last characters so the user can tell links apart. Takes effect immediately and cannot be undone; that link stops opening the scene for everyone who has it. Other tokens and the scene are untouched. Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

scene.description: Scene id (e.g. palm-villa-0a1b2c3d4e5f), the job id returned by upload_scene, or a Verse share link.

share_id.description: The shareId to revoke. Omit to list active ones.

name: revoke_share_link

revoked.description: The share id that was revoked.

shares.description: Active share tokens (id and last characters), when listing.

title: Revoke a private share link
